heading: Identity and handover verification
description: Vehicle is checked against stolen-vehicle records and the handover is documented.
points: Vehicle is validated on VAHAN & stolen records
Handover is documented with date, time & location
protectionMessage: This protects you from disputes later by proving the vehicle was genuine and handed over by the right person.

heading: Certificate registered on VAHAN
description: Once scrapping is approved, the Certificate of Vehicle Scrapping is generated and pushed directly to the VAHAN portal against your registration number.
points: Certificate of Vehicle Scrapping (CVS) generated digitally
Vehicle status updated to "Scrapped" on VAHAN
Registration number permanently linked to the certificate
protectionMessage: This protects you from future liability - the government record shows your vehicle was legally scrapped, not just resold informally.

heading: Proof of the physical cut is captured
description: The exact moment your vehicle is irreversibly dismantled is recorded on camera with a timestamp, so there is indisputable proof scrapping actually happened.
points: Cutting event recorded on facility CCTV with timestamp
Chassis number visibly cut and photographed
Footage retained as part of the compliance file
protectionMessage: This protects you from someone re-registering or misusing your vehicle's identity after scrapping.

heading: Every material is tracked end-to-end
description: Recovered steel, aluminium, copper and other materials are logged and traced from your vehicle to the certified recycling stream.
points: Recovered material weighed and logged by category
Steel, aluminium & copper tracked to certified recyclers
Traceability ID links materials back to your vehicle
protectionMessage: This protects the environment and proves your vehicle was recycled responsibly, not dumped or informally scrapped.

heading: Your record stays retrievable, always
description: Every document from handover to certificate is stored securely and can be retrieved on demand - for insurance, RTO queries, or your own peace of mind.
points: All documents archived in a secure digital record
Retrievable anytime using your vehicle or certificate number
Available for RTO, insurance, or legal reference
protectionMessage: This protects you years later - if a dispute ever comes up, your proof is always one search away.
